texto.titulo: A perfect evening? / Uma noite perfeita?
texto.ru: It was such a lovely evening that we stayed outside until midnight. The food was so good that everybody asked for more. There were too many people, but the garden was big enough. I was too tired to dance, so I sat with a few friends. We had enough time to talk about everything. It was so peaceful that nobody wanted to leave.
texto.pt: Foi uma noite tão agradável que ficamos do lado de fora até meia-noite. A comida estava tão boa que todos pediram mais. Havia gente demais, mas o jardim era grande o bastante. Eu estava cansado demais para dançar, então fiquei sentado com alguns amigos. Tivemos tempo suficiente para falar de tudo. Estava tão tranquilo que ninguém queria ir embora.

perguntas.pergunta: Why did everyone ask for more food?
